patch_description: The previous attempt increased parameter count to 74, causing a significant performance drop compared to the 26-parameter design (which achieved a score of 0.56). I am reverting the ANSATZ_SPEC to the parameter-efficient configuration used in the successful iteration: using only 4 trainable parameters per block (coarse-grained RY and RZ sharing) while retaining the effective entanglement topology (two interleaved rings + opposite-chord CZ gates).
